title: 586. Word Abbreviation

examples.explanation: "internal" and "interval" collide until the full word is needed; "intension" and "intrusion" separate with longer prefixes.
One-letter prefixes already separate the two words.
Further prefixes would not shorten "world"/"would", so both keep full forms that are already unique.

hints: Start every word with a one-letter prefix abbreviation, keeping the original when it is not shorter.
Group words by their current abbreviation; any group with more than one member needs longer prefixes.
Repeat the growth step until every group holds exactly one word.
